prompts.head_south:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create ONE isolated front-facing HEAD texture for Vertin (维尔汀), for a RimWorld chibi character mod, genuine transparent background.
Reference image 1 is the USER'S PORTRAIT identity/costume source. Reference image 2 is a detail board of the same portrait. Reference image 3 is the already accepted earlier local reference (removed) head: match its petite 2D anime chibi face, soft ink edge, restrained flat color/shadow, matte low-resolution game-sprite finish. Do not copy its black hairstyle.
Subject details to faithfully retain: pale skin; muted gray-green eyes and calm serious expression; short layered ash-beige/silver hair (slightly taupe, not bright yellow), distinctive long curved side-swept forelock across the forehead, small curled locks framing cheeks and short tucked/nape hair. Wear the portrait's dark plum-black low top hat with broad oval brim, muted desaturated blue-teal hatband and side bow; two short softly folded ribbon tails with dark end tips tucked behind hair. The hat is worn normally rather than floating. Do not exaggerate its height.
Strict orthographic FRONT view, level face, no tilt, no 3/4 angle. Centered complete head, all hat brim, hair tips and ribbon ends inside canvas with clear transparent margins. HEAD ONLY: no shoulders, chest, clothing collar, jabot, hands, torso or background. Keep rounded chibi face proportions, hair and eyes readable when reduced to about 90 native pixels wide. Hat is extra above the usual head, do not shrink the face to make the hat enormous. Soft subdued drawing; no glossy realism, no hard geometric/vector bevels, no airbrush portrait lighting, no decorative sparkles, no ground shadow. No text, labels, grid or watermark. One head only.
prompts.body_south:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Generate ONE isolated FRONT-facing headless BODY clothing texture of Vertin (维尔汀) for a RimWorld chibi mod. Genuine transparent background.
Image 1 is the USER'S ORIGINAL PORTRAIT and controls costume identity. Image 2 magnifies its details. Image 3 is the approved current earlier local reference (removed) body and controls compact body proportions, fitted narrow waist, hips slightly wider than shoulders, short inward-converging legs, armless 2D chibi game-sprite treatment and soft matte line finish. Replace its entire tactical outfit with Vertin's original costume; do not add tactical equipment.
Accurate costume: elegant deep violet/ink-purple fitted frock/tail coat, black patterned high collar and lapel trim with very restrained scrolling embroidery, a layered off-white frilled cravat/jabot at center chest, near-black waistcoat/interior and black fitted trousers. Small quiet silver/dull pewter buttons. Lower coat splits into a pair of curved tail panels down to mid-calf, showing the original muted smoky blue-teal lining along folded inner edges, compact close to the legs, not a huge cape. Tall dark plum/navy boots with small paired square silver buckles near upper outer shafts and a restrained folded indigo inset/tab like the source. Short black toes point downward/forward in front view and touch at center, never splay sideways. Preserve recognizable coat seams, overlapping lapels, several frill tiers, boot cuff details at miniature resolution.
No head, face, hair or hat. A tiny central neck opening is allowed. NO ARMS AND NO HANDS, no hanging long sleeves or elbow shapes. At shoulders at most tiny coat sleeve caps with a hint of the source's cuff ornament, integrated into torso silhouette. Front symmetrical standing armless pawn pose; feet close; arms absent; torso about the same shoulder/hip width ratio as image 3. Slight stylized inward leg taper. This is flat-ish hand-drawn 2D Q-version: muted local color areas with a few soft cloth fold strokes, subtle simplified block shadow only. No shiny boots, no realistic fabric rendering, no bright saturated purple, no polished 3D highlights, no aggressive black vector polygons. Preserve portrait's purple/teal/ivory colors, NOT an all-black recolor.
Full body from neck opening to boot soles, centered on a square transparent canvas with wide empty margins; no crop, no ground shadow, no text or watermark. One body only.
prompts.head_east:

Preserve exactly the ash-beige/silver short curled hairstyle, pale skin, muted gray-green eyes, dark plum-black low top hat, smoky blue-teal band, bow and two folded ribbon tails with dark tips. Match image 1's ink/color/shading treatment and scale; soft miniature 2D game sprite rather than a realistic portrait. Head stays level, upright. Maintain approximately the same head and hat pixel size as image 1 on the same square canvas; put its chin/nape bottom at the same height. Complete head including hat and ribbons with transparent margins. NO shoulders, no torso, no clothing collar, no necktie, no arms/hands; no text, labels, other heads, backdrop or floor shadow.
Required view: exact orthographic RIGHT-FACING PROFILE, nose points to image right, one eye visible, true side silhouette, not three-quarter. Hat's front brim points right, hair curls at cheek and nape, brim and crown in side profile. The hat's bow is on the CHARACTER'S LEFT side (viewer-right in the front reference), which is visible from this left-side profile. Preserve that same bow and dark-tipped ribbons behind the ear; do not invent a ponytail. Keep calm neutral expression, small chibi nose. Rotate only the view of the head, no forward head tilt.

prompts.body_east:
Use case: identity-preserve. Generate ONE isolated headless BODY clothing sprite of the exact Vertin outfit in image 1 (the front body design). Image 2 is the user's original portrait. Reconstruct the requested direction without changing character costume. Transparent background.
Preserve: fitted deep ink-purple/violet frock coat, dark subtly embroidered stand collar/lapel and small shoulder caps, muted blue-teal lining, near-black fitted waistcoat and trousers, small silver square/diamond buttons, calf-length split coat tails, tall dark plum/navy boots with paired small square buckles and folded indigo side tabs. Keep the front design's same garment lengths, trim colors, boot heights, compact neck-to-feet proportions. Image 1's frilled ivory jabot is on the FRONT of chest only. Restrained detailing and softened hand-painted 2D chibi local color blocks, matte low-contrast folds; no glossy highlights or photorealistic fabric.
NO head/face/hair/hat; no arms/hands and no long dangling empty sleeves. Shoulder caps at most short stubs integrated into torso. No tactical pouches, backpacks, straps, belts or new accessories. Legs close and taper inward. Boots follow downward leg lines, not widely splayed. Entire neck-to-boot body centered, transparent margins, single sprite, no labels/grid/shadow.
Required view: exact right-facing PROFILE, chest and toe tips face image right. NEUTRAL UPRIGHT pose before a later software pose adjustment: neck, waist and ankles near a vertical axis, NO overall lean and NO walking stride. Only a small rounded forward boot toe. Show near shoulder cap, curved fitted waist, front frill peeking from collar/chest edge on the RIGHT, front lapel edge, split coattail behind to LEFT with soft blue-teal lining folds. Coattail stays tucked close behind legs, not swept horizontally. Boot square buckles and indigo tab on near outer shaft remain visible. Side is narrower than front with one near leg and a sliver of far leg. Keep neck opening near same vertical point and soles at same height as reference.
